title: 1936 Prairie's railed roof deck sits where its photograph shows it
items: In 1904, the railed lookout on top of the Thompson-Allerton house at 1936 Prairie Avenue is now smaller. It stops about a metre short of the front and well short of the north side, as the house's photograph shows it. It used to run almost the whole length of the roof.
The chimney on the north side of the roof has moved behind the tower. The photograph shows open sky where it used to stand.
